$comment: Direct uses of the unscoped ctx.prisma in API routers, per file, with the reason. Checked by tools/scripts/check-unscoped-prisma.mjs; lower `max` when uses go away, never raise it without a reason.

apps/api/src/modules/agent/agent.router..reason: Approval-policy and tool-registry lookups take the tenant as an argument; each call runs after requireTenantOwnedAction or with ctx.user.tenantId.

apps/api/src/modules/agent/conversation..reason: Admin analytics and archiving on adminProcedure, which has no tenant-scoped client; every query filters by ctx.user.tenantId.

apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.router.ts.reason: Sign-in, session and MFA records belong to the user, not to a tenant, and are looked up by the authenticated user id.

apps/api/src/modules/billing/billing.rou.reason: Usage counts for the billing period filter every query by the caller's tenantId explicitly.

apps/api/src/modules/calendar/public-boo.reason: Public booking pages have no session: the event type and its tenant are resolved from the booking handle, and the writes and host lookup use that tenant and event type.

apps/api/src/modules/inbound/inbound.rou.reason: Server-to-server portal calls with no user session, authenticated by the shared internal secret; every lead, task and appointment query filters by the tenant the call is for.

apps/api/src/modules/partner/partner.rou.reason: Partner operations act on client tenants by design; loadPartnerTenant checks the partner owns the tenant first.

apps/api/src/modules/privacy/privacy-adm.reason: Reads the caller's own tenant record (the Tenant model has no tenantId column).

apps/api/src/modules/privacy/privacy-pub.reason: Public privacy pages have no session: a data request is read by the id in its download link (only to record the download against its own tenant), and a tenant by its public booking handle.

apps/api/src/modules/security/audit.rout.reason: Admin security views on adminProcedure, which has no tenant-scoped client; every query filters by ctx.user.tenantId.

apps/api/src/modules/user/user-membershi.reason: A user's memberships span tenants by design (ADR-071): listing and switching them reads rows outside the active tenant.

apps/api/src/modules/zep/zep-budget.rout.reason: Fallback only when no tenant-scoped client is present; the budget is keyed by the caller's tenantId.
